ch0242_41_masaru/0101_0701_02_10:
When you’re ready, let’s go together!
But take your time!
ch0242_41_masaru/7101_0701_01_10:
At the academy, I’m usually just a student
who takes classes...
ch0242_41_masaru/7101_0701_02_10:
But by teaching others what I learn, I feel
like I understand it better.
ch0242_41_masaru/7101_0701_03_10:
Studying with friends from Pasio Academy
helps too!
ch0242_41_masaru/7102_0701_01_10: I have a habit of thinking too deeply...
ch0242_41_masaru/7102_0701_02_10:
But tests have a time limit, so I can’t think
forever.
ch0242_41_masaru/7102_0701_03_10: I may need to practice answering quicker.
ch0242_41_masaru/7103_0701_01_10:
When I attend the academy in this uniform,
I feel more focused!
ch0242_41_masaru/7103_0701_02_10:
It’s like when I wear the uniform for Galar’s
Gym Challenge.
ch0242_41_masaru/7103_0701_03_10: It gets me in the zone.
ch0242_41_masaru/7103_0701_04_10:
Or at least I feel like it does.
Is it psychological?
ch0242_41_masaru/7104_0701_01_10:
It’s exciting how many events there are at
school outside of classes!
ch0242_41_masaru/7104_0701_02_10:
Do you think we’ll go on a school trip at
some point?
ch0242_41_masaru/7104_0701_03_10:
If we all go camping and cook together,
we’ll make some great memories!
ch0242_41_masaru/7105_0701_02_10: I made too many snacks for the Pokémon.
ch0242_41_masaru/7105_0701_03_10:
I’ve plenty to share, so if you get hungry
between classes, let me know!
ch0242_41_masaru/1701_0701_01_10:
How’s the studying coming? Here, I’ve got
something that might help!
ch0242_41_masaru/1701_0702_01_10:
We students need to help each other out!
Let me know if you’re ever in trouble!
ch0242_41_masaru/2501_0701_01_10:
I think at Pasio Academy, the class I enjoy
most is home economics!
ch0242_41_masaru/2501_0701_02_10:
I’m so glad to be able to learn about
cooking!
ch0242_41_masaru/2501_0702_01_10: Huh? Why don’t I teach a class?
ch0242_41_masaru/2501_0702_03_10:
Maybe I’ll give it a shot using my experience
hosting a cooking class on Pasio!
ch0242_41_masaru/2511_0701_01_10:
When I lived in Postwick, the surrounding
nature was basically my teacher.
ch0242_41_masaru/2511_0701_02_10:
Even when I was just playing, there were
subtle differences every day, which always
made me think.
ch0242_41_masaru/2511_0702_01_10:
I bet there are opportunities to learn all
around us.
ch0242_41_masaru/2511_0702_02_10:
I wanna do my best to take in all kinds of
knowledge and experience!
ch0242_41_masaru/3001_0701_01_10:
I’m a morning person. I used to get up early
to explore the Wild Area back home all
the time.
ch0242_41_masaru/3003_0701_01_10:
Here’s the secret to making the best curry
ever: don’t over-fan the flames! And when
you start mixing, do it nice and slow!
ch0242_41_masaru/3005_0701_01_10:
I like camping out at night in my tent.
Looking up at the night sky sends me right
to sleep.
